Best Sunday Roast in Town
Jan 2019 • Couples
The Sunday roast at D2 Sports Bar is exceptional. Super hot and particularly tasty. Each week offers a different meat for Sunday roast but for a little extra you can change your meat to one of your choice. I normally elect for the chicken which is beautifully sliced , the best white meat part of the chicken and plentiful. The veggies are varied and cooked to perfection and the mashed potato is the best in Ho Chi Minh - a correct texture mashed with real butter that you can taste. The gray is delicious too and completes the wonderful roast experience. If I have one small complaint it is that the roast potatoes are soft on the outside and lack that crispness normally associated with roast potatoes but they do not spoil an otherwise delicious experience. There is a good range of wines on offer too to complement the meal. The Sunday roast is deserving of a 5 star rating but I have settled on a 4 star rating for the restaurant overall when taking into account other meals eaten there during the week. For example, the french fries are delightful - to a nice thickness and piping hot, crispy on the outside and soft and fluffy on the outside. But I find the minced beef and pie a little too dry, although it is served with a tasty gravy on the side, and there is an overriding taste of herbs, not normally associated with a beef pie. But for a Sunday roast? In this realm D2 Sports Bar cannot be beaten . We have tried all the Sunday roasts in town and whilst one or two are very good, D2 Sports Bar Sunday roasts are in a class of their own.
